theorem norm_Gr_le_closed (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ : θ < π / 4)
    (hs0 : -1 ≤ s.re) (hs1 : s.re ≤ 1) :
    ‖Gr s δ 0‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(θ * |s.im|)) *
      (Real.exp ((2 * π * |δ| * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 / (2 * Real.cos (2 * θ))) *
        ((1 + (2 * π * |δ| * Real.sin θ / Real.cos (2 * θ)) ^ 2) * √(π / (Real.cos (2 * θ) / 2)) +
          √π / (Real.cos (2 * θ) * √(Real.cos (2 * θ) / 2)))) :=

note: The book uses this theorem only through Cor 8.0.2; Ch. 9 (expform l.606, l.794) mentions direct use as an option. Erratum: The good-sign bound (8.3) is false for small rho=4|tau|/ell^2 (s=1+i, delta=1: |F|=0.017470 against 4.16e-8; asymptotically it fails for rho below about 0.8156, the claim's 0.8137 being the approximation rho^2+6pi rho=16), because the L_3 step on p.158 uses a Gaussian tail bound that needs ell>=0 while ell<0 (checked by `scripts/checks/theorem_8_0_1.py`).
